scope: CI wiring only; no product Python, product JavaScript, models, migrations or runtime settings changed

node_unique_contracts.counting: The 21 export/control cases include the earlier 17 export cases. That earlier driver is not run separately.

browser_wiring.reason: Both drivers share one fresh process so the export driver can find diary records persisted by the diary driver.
browser_wiring.readiness: Require HTTP health and a parsed JSON marker emitted after real fixture registrations. Marker must identify personal-diary-ui, 26 metadata tables and model target 20261019_personal_diary. This is a fixture metadata assertion, not evidence of an executed migration.
browser_wiring.failure_behavior: Each driver and report is mandatory. A failed driver, missing/malformed report, insufficient checks/screens, or dead fixture fails the step. Existing EXIT cleanup remains active.

local_validation.history: First and final review outputs are preserved. The final origin-only rerun records the current case labels and UTF-8 report. The PowerShell UTF-16 capture is retained separately and is not used by the UTF-8 report guard.
